pages.title: Find your way around
pages.description: Open a tool in its own tab, look at one property, and find Settings and the Assistant.
pages.intro: Everything in the app starts from the top of the window: the tabs, the switch between the whole portfolio and one property, and Settings. Learn these once and every other page of this guide is easy to follow.

sections.title: Open a tool in a tab
sections.text: The **Portfolio** tab is always first. Underwriting, the Calendar and Data Health each open in a tab of their own, next to it.

steps.text: Click **+** at the end of the tab strip. A menu lists the tools that open in a tab.

marks.text: Opens this menu.

marks.label: The tools
marks.text: Underwriting & Sizing, the Maturity & Reset Calendar and Data Health.

steps.text: Click a tool. It opens as a new tab and comes to the front. Here Underwriting, the Calendar and Data Health are all open, with Data Health in front.

marks.label: The tab in front
marks.text: White, and joined to the page below it.
Closes the tab.

steps.text: Click **Portfolio** to go back. Each tab keeps its place while you look at another, and choosing a tool again from **+** just brings its tab forward.
Click **×** on a tab to close it. Nothing is lost: your files and figures are saved with each property.

callouts.text: Drag a tab left or right to change the order. The arrow on a tab (**Pop out**) opens it in a window of its own, handy on a second screen; **Dock into main window** in that window puts it back.

steps.text: Under the tabs, click **Specific Property**, then pick the property in the list. Its loans, NOI, payment schedule and profile show below.

marks.label: Specific Property
marks.text: One property at a time.

marks.label: The property
marks.text: Pick the property to show.

steps.text: Click **Whole Portfolio** to go back to the whole book.

Click **Settings** at the top right of the window. Its menu has the app’s size, the portfolio targets, your properties, this guide and the Claude connection. Click outside the menu, or press Esc, to close it.

marks.label: Settings
marks.text: Opens and closes the menu.

marks.label: Open the guide
marks.text: Opens this guide.

steps.text: Click the green **Assistant** button at the bottom right, on any tab, to ask Claude about your portfolio or to have it do something in the app.

marks.label: Assistant
marks.text: Opens the assistant.

callouts.text: The Assistant needs Claude to be connected. See [Connect Claude](connect-claude).

next.text: Open a loan and read its page.
Every control on the main screen, named.

pages.title: Make the app bigger or smaller
pages.description: Zoom the whole app, the way you zoom a web page.
pages.intro: App scale in Settings changes the size of everything at once. At 75% more of a page fits on the screen; at 150% everything is easier to read.

steps.text: Click **Settings** at the top right of the window.
Drag the **App scale** slider, or click one of the sizes under it. The whole app changes size at once.

marks.label: App scale
marks.text: Drag it: from 50% to 200%, in steps of 5%.

marks.label: Reset to 100%
marks.text: Back to the normal size.

steps.text: To go back to the normal size, click **Reset to 100%**.

callouts.text: The window bar at the top never changes size, so Settings is always easy to reach. The app opens at 100% each time you start it.

next.text: The tabs, the switch and Settings.
Everything in the Settings and Data menus.

pages.title: Check today’s market rates
pages.description: Fetch the live rates that the refinance and the Portfolio page use.
pages.intro: The app holds every rate a loan can float on: Prime, SOFR, Term SOFR, Fed Funds and the US Treasuries. **Fetch live rate** asks the US feeds for today’s values. The refinance, the rate columns on the Portfolio page and the loan form’s rate preview use the new values at once.
before: An internet connection. Without one, the app keeps using the rates it already holds.

steps.text: Click **Fetch live rate** in the window bar at the top.
Read the list. Each row is one rate: its value today, where that value comes from, and which of your loans use it.

marks.label: Value
marks.text: The rate today, in percent.

marks.label: Where it comes from
marks.text: “live” with the date it was quoted, the last rate fetched, or the app’s built-in rate.

marks.label: Your loans on it
marks.text: Every loan that uses this rate, floating, hybrid or fixed.

steps.text: Click **Close**, or anywhere outside the list. The rates stay updated.

callouts.text: “Built-in rate — fetch to update” means the feeds didn’t return that rate this time, so the app uses its stored value. In this picture only one rate came back from the feeds.

next.text: Use today’s rate to decide on a refinance.
Compare each property’s rate with the market’s.

pages.title: The main screen
pages.description: Every part of the window you see on every tab: the window bar, the header, the tabs and the switch under them.
pages.intro: Each picture names its controls. Point at a number, on the picture or in the list, to find it.

views.text: The app opens on the Portfolio tab. From the top: the window bar, the header, the tabs, the switch and the Data menu, and the Needs Attention strip. The Portfolio page starts below them.

marks.label: Window bar
marks.text: The app’s own title bar. Drag it to move the window.

marks.label: Fetch live rate
marks.text: Fetches today’s market rates and lists them. See [Check today’s market rates](check-market-rates).

marks.label: Settings
marks.text: The app’s size, the portfolio targets, your properties, this guide and the Claude connection.

marks.label: Minimize
marks.text: Hides the window to the taskbar.

marks.label: Maximize
marks.text: Fills the screen; click again to go back to the size it was.

marks.label: Close
marks.text: Closes the app.

marks.label: Living Residential
marks.text: The app’s name; nothing to click.

marks.label: Property count
marks.text: How many properties are in the portfolio. Archived properties aren’t counted.

marks.label: Version
marks.text: The version you have. Click it to check for a new version.

marks.label: Portfolio tab
marks.text: This page. It is always the first tab and can’t be closed.
Opens Underwriting, the Calendar or Data Health in a tab of its own.

marks.label: Whole Portfolio
marks.text: The whole book on one page (shown now).

marks.label: Specific Property
marks.text: One property at a time: its loans, payment schedule and profile.

marks.label: Data
marks.text: Back up, restore, and Excel export and import.

marks.label: Needs Attention
marks.text: Dates coming up and loans worth refinancing. Click a card to go there.

marks.label: Portfolio
marks.text: The Portfolio page: totals, charts, coverage and every loan.

sections.title: The window bar and the header

views.title: The rates list
views.text: Opened by **Fetch live rate**: every rate the app holds, its value, where the value comes from, and which of your loans use it.

marks.label: Market rates
marks.text: The list of every rate the app holds.

marks.label: How many were refreshed
marks.text: How many rates came fresh from the US feeds just now, out of how many the app holds.

marks.label: Close
marks.text: Closes the list (so does clicking outside it). The rates stay updated.

marks.label: Rate
marks.text: The rate’s name: Prime, SOFR, Term SOFR, Fed Funds, the US Treasuries and “Other”.

marks.label: Value
marks.text: The rate today, in percent.

marks.label: Where it comes from
marks.text: “live” with the date it was quoted; “Built-in rate — fetch to update” is the app’s stored value; “Last saved rate” is the last value fetched.

marks.label: Your loans on it
marks.text: Every loan that uses this rate, and whether it is floating, hybrid or fixed (a fixed loan’s rate is locked and doesn’t move).

views.title: The version and the window buttons

marks.label: Property count
marks.text: How many properties are in the portfolio (archived ones aren’t counted).

marks.label: Version
marks.text: Your version. Click to check for an update; it then reads “Checking for updates…”, “Downloading update… %”, and finally “Update ready — Restart”.

marks.label: Minimize
marks.text: Hides the window to the taskbar.

marks.label: Maximize / Restore
marks.text: Fills the screen, or puts the window back to its size.

marks.label: Close
marks.text: Closes the app.

marks.label: Portfolio
marks.text: The Portfolio tab: always there, can’t be closed.
Opens this menu. Click it again to close the menu.

marks.label: Underwriting & Sizing
marks.text: A property’s T12, its underwriting (Safe and Aggressive, approved by you), loan sizing and what to push.

marks.label: Maturity & Reset Calendar
marks.text: Every maturity, rate reset and interest-only change, month by month.

marks.label: Data Health
marks.text: What is missing or needs a look, across every property.

marks.label: Portfolio
marks.text: Back to the Portfolio page.

marks.label: Underwriting
marks.text: An open tab. Click to bring it to the front.

marks.label: Calendar
marks.text: Another open tab.

marks.label: Data Health (in front)
marks.text: The tab showing now: white, and joined to the page below.

marks.label: Pop out
marks.text: Opens this tab in a window of its own. The tab leaves the strip while its window is open; in the window, “Dock into main window” puts it back here as it was, and closing the window closes the tool.

marks.label: Close tab
marks.text: Closes the tab. If it was in front, you land back on Portfolio.

views.title: Whole Portfolio
views.text: The whole book: Needs Attention, the totals, the charts, coverage per property, the forecast and every loan. See [The Portfolio page](ref-portfolio).

marks.label: Whole Portfolio
marks.text: Shows the whole book (green = the one showing).

marks.label: Specific Property
marks.text: Switches to one property.

marks.label: Data
marks.text: Backups and Excel: the same menu on both sides of the switch.

marks.label: Needs Attention
marks.text: Shown on the whole-portfolio side only.

views.title: Specific Property
views.text: One property at a time. See [The property page](ref-property-page).

marks.label: Specific Property
marks.text: One property at a time (showing now).

marks.label: Whole Portfolio
marks.text: Back to the whole book.

marks.label: Select a property
marks.text: The property to show. Pick another one here.

marks.label: Add Loan
marks.text: Adds a loan, to this property or a new one.

marks.label: Add Property
marks.text: Adds a property; a name is enough to start.

marks.label: Edit
marks.text: Edits this property’s details.

marks.label: Remove
marks.text: Archives this property and its loans (they can be brought back from the Portfolio page).

marks.label: Refi Calculator
marks.text: Opens the refinance for this property.

views.text: At the bottom right of every tab. See [Ask the assistant](ask-the-assistant).

marks.label: Assistant
marks.text: Opens the assistant window, about 80% of the app’s size.
